title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 32
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 32: the lamentation over Pharaoh, the darkened heavens, and the nations already lying in the lower parts of the earth.

questions.text: To what was Pharaoh likened at the start of the lamentation?
questions.explanation: The lamentation says he was likened to a young lion of the nations, yet he is as a monster in the seas who troubled the waters with his feet.

answers.text: To a cedar in Lebanon
To a staff of reed
To an eagle of the sky
To a young lion of the nations

questions.text: What would be spread out over Pharaoh with a company of many peoples?
questions.explanation: He says: I will spread out my net on you with a company of many peoples, and they will bring you up in my net.

answers.text: A cloud
A net
A sword
A veil

questions.text: What would settle on him when he was cast out on the open field?
questions.explanation: He says he will leave him on the land and cast him out on the open field, and will cause all the birds of the sky to settle on him.

answers.text: All the birds of the sky
All the fish of the rivers
All the flocks of the mountains
All the peoples of the countries

questions.text: What is said about the sun and the moon when he is extinguished?
questions.explanation: He says he will cover the heavens and make their stars dark, cover the sun with a cloud, and the moon will not give its light.

answers.text: The sun would rise twice in the day
The moon would stand still in the sky
The sun would be covered and the moon give no light
The sun would burn the land and the moon turn red

questions.text: Whose sword would come on Egypt?
questions.explanation: The Lord Yahweh says: the sword of the king of Babylon will come on you.

answers.text: The sword of the king of Babylon
The sword of the king of Assyria
The sword of the princes of the sea
The sword of the children of the east

questions.text: What would Egypt's rivers be made to run like?
questions.explanation: He says: then I will make their waters clear, and cause their rivers to run like oil.

answers.text: Like blood
Like oil
Like wine
Like milk

questions.text: Who would lament with this lamentation over Egypt?
questions.explanation: The chapter says this is the lamentation with which they will lament, and that the daughters of the nations will lament with it over Egypt and all her multitude.

answers.text: The kings of the islands
The priests of Memphis
The daughters of the nations
The merchants of Tyre

questions.text: Which nation is named first among those already lying there with all her company and her graves around her?
questions.explanation: The chapter says: Asshur is there with all her company, her graves are all around her, all of them slain, fallen by the sword.

answers.text: Asshur
Elam
Edom
Sidon

questions.text: Which group is named together with all the Sidonians as having gone down with the slain?
questions.explanation: It says there are the princes of the north, all of them, and all the Sidonians, who have gone down with the slain and are put to shame.

answers.text: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah
The princes of Tyre and the islands
The kings of the children of the east
The princes of the north

questions.text: What does the chapter say Pharaoh would do when he saw them?
questions.explanation: It says Pharaoh will see them and will be comforted over all his multitude, even Pharaoh and all his army, slain by the sword.

answers.text: He would turn back to his land
He would be comforted over all his multitude
He would call for his wise men
He would gather his ships again
